analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch excerpt shows the table at head lines ~1087-1090 (prefill geometry: Gemma 4 wide chunk 2048/4096, others 512/2048; solo-prefill stripe rules; a bidirectional media prefill chunk ceiling of 512) and Flint text at head lines 2041-2060. The supplied units are base text at lines 1629-2248, which sit outside the changed ranges and are unchanged context; the changed hunks at 1101-1159 are not visible in the supplied units. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption, cache-storage or key-handling behavior is altered in the visible content.

I checked the documented prefill geometry against T-041, which covers the prefix cache and its timing oracle. Chunk size and step-token changes affect throughput and memory, and the documented env overrides (DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS) are operator-local. The visible docs do not change cache scope, HMAC lookup, TTL, KEK or coordinator salt derivation. Wider prefill chunks for Gemma 4 could in principle shift memory pressure and the TTFT oracle, but that is a runtime change not evidenced in this docs-only diff. Memory admission (GlobalKVCacheBudget, process ledger) is described as unchanged.

Remaining question for integration: the actual implementation of EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift (prefillGeometry) is outside the supplied evidence. If it ships alongside this doc, it should be reviewed for memory-admission and DoS interaction with the wider chunk (TB-007, T-029). The Flint doc edits at head 2041-2060 were not visible as head text, so I could not verify them. No finding is raised from the supplied documentation alone.
